# Kantione

> Kantione is a concert series curated by Eleni Poulou at Haus am Waldsee in Berlin, exploring connections between early and contemporary music.

## Pages

- [About Kantione and visitor information](https://kanti.one/)
- [Concerts](https://kanti.one/concerts/)
- [Past concerts](https://kanti.one/archive/)
- [Homepage in Markdown](https://kanti.one/index.md)
- [Haus am Waldsee legal information](https://hausamwaldsee.de/impressum/)

## Contact

For accessibility questions, contact [info@hausamwaldsee.de](mailto:info@hausamwaldsee.de).
Tickets are available [online](https://hausamwaldsee.de/tickets/) or at the box office.
